text:
sam-partnerships: Quick flag 1: Nitro reported longer lead times on next-gen racks (H200 series). This could affect committed Dedicated capacity for late-June launches. Need rapid prioritization.
olga-nitro: Confirmed 1: thermal chamber backlog plus a parts shortage pushing some shipments 2-4 weeks. We can prioritize up to 3 customer orders per week for partial shipments if you provide priority IDs.
devon-ops: Which customers are impacted? we track three late-June rollouts: acct-orion, acct-sable, acct-niva. Orion is enterprise with SLA.
yasmin-sales: Orion and Sable are high-touch. Niva is a small pilot. Sales wants Orion prioritized.
harry-eng: Technical tradeoffs: partial racks -> reduced peak throughput; marketplace VMs -> higher latency and cost; GPU swaps -> performance variance. We should quantify expected throughput loss per option.
sam-partnerships: Action: list of priority customers to Nitro by EOD, plus fallback plan. @marketplace-bot any marketplace capacity in eu/na?
marketplace-bot: Available marketplace quota: h200-emulated VMs: region-us-east-1: 8, region-eu-west-1: 6. Estimated provisioning lead ~4 days for reserved VMs.
yasmin-sales: 4 days might be OK for Sable and Niva but not Orion.
olga-nitro: We can rush-configure one Orion rack this week if you accept a 12% expedite fee and sign a swap acknowledgement.
devon-ops: If we accept Nitro rush, ops needs manifest + serials for compliance. Also raise incident to track compensations.
harry-eng: For software mitigations, we can enable asymmetric routing: 70% to Dedicated when available, 30% to marketplace VMs with cache warming and extended batching for stability.
sam-partnerships: Good. Yasmin, run this with Orion and get sign-off for expedite fee. Devon, open an incident INC-2026-0610 and add cost tracking. Harry, please produce a perf delta estimate (A vs H200 emulation) by noon tomorrow.
yasmin-sales: On it. I'll propose 10% service credit for any impacted usage and confirm whether Orion will accept expedite.
olga-nitro: I'll send formal ETA + QC notes once I have the priority list.
devon-ops: Incident INC-2026-0610 created 1: "Partner H200 lead-time impact on Dedicated" 1 priority: P2.
sam-partnerships: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in partnerships sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
